headline: Sepsis-3: new definitions of sepsis and septic shock
summary: Sepsis is redefined as life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated response to infection, identified by a rise of 2 or more SOFA points; qSOFA is proposed as a bedside prompt.
why: Replaced SIRS-based definitions used in emergency departments and wards worldwide.
cr_title: The Third International Consensus Definitions for Sepsis and Septic Shock (Sepsis-3)

headline: LEADER: liraglutide lowers cardiovascular events in type 2 diabetes
summary: In 9,340 adults with type 2 diabetes at high cardiovascular risk, liraglutide reduced major cardiovascular events and cardiovascular death compared with placebo.
why: First GLP-1 receptor agonist shown to reduce cardiovascular death; began the shift to outcome-driven diabetes drug choice.
cr_title: Liraglutide and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Type 2 Diabetes

headline: 2016 ESC/EAS guidelines for the management of dyslipidaemias
summary: European guidance on lipid testing, risk-based LDL cholesterol targets and treatment.
why: Reference for lipid targets in Europe and the Middle East until the 2019 update.
cr_title: 2016 ESC/EAS Guidelines for the Management of Dyslipidaemias

headline: Venetoclax in relapsed chronic lymphocytic leukaemia
summary: Targeting BCL2 with venetoclax produced responses in about 79% of 116 patients with relapsed or refractory CLL.
why: Led to the first approval of a BCL2 inhibitor (FDA, April 2016).
cr_title: Targeting BCL2 with Venetoclax in Relapsed Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia

headline: FOURIER: evolocumab added to a statin lowers cardiovascular events
summary: In 27,564 patients with atherosclerotic disease on statins, adding evolocumab lowered LDL cholesterol and reduced major cardiovascular events (about 15% relative reduction in the primary endpoint).
why: Showed that lowering LDL cholesterol far below earlier targets is beneficial; supports PCSK9-inhibitor use in very-high-risk patients.
cr_title: Evolocumab and Clinical Outcomes in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease

headline: CANTOS: targeting inflammation with canakinumab lowers cardiovascular events
summary: In 10,061 patients after myocardial infarction with raised hs-CRP, canakinumab 150 mg reduced recurrent cardiovascular events without lowering cholesterol.
why: First proof that lowering inflammation, independent of lipids, reduces atherosclerotic events; not adopted widely because of infection risk and cost.
cr_title: Antiinflammatory Therapy with Canakinumab for Atherosclerotic Disease

headline: COMPASS: low-dose rivaroxaban plus aspirin in stable vascular disease
summary: In 27,395 patients with stable coronary or peripheral artery disease, rivaroxaban 2.5 mg twice daily plus aspirin reduced cardiovascular events versus aspirin alone, with more major bleeding.
why: Opened the option of dual-pathway inhibition for selected high-risk outpatients.
cr_title: Rivaroxaban with or without Aspirin in Stable Cardiovascular Disease

headline: CANVAS: canagliflozin and cardiovascular events in type 2 diabetes
summary: An integrated analysis of two trials in 10,142 participants found fewer major cardiovascular events with canagliflozin and an increased risk of amputation.
why: Part of the evidence that moved SGLT2 inhibitors from glucose-lowering drugs to cardiovascular and kidney protection.
cr_title: Canagliflozin and Cardiovascular and Renal Events in Type 2 Diabetes

headline: 2017 ACC/AHA high blood pressure guideline
summary: Defines hypertension as 130/80 mmHg or higher and recommends earlier treatment with out-of-office confirmation.
why: Changed the US threshold and prompted worldwide debate; European guidelines kept 140/90 for diagnosis.
cr_title: 2017 ACC/AHA/AAPA/ABC/ACPM/AGS/APhA/ASH/ASPC/NMA/PCNA Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults: A Report of the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association Task Force on Clinical Practice Guidelines

headline: ZUMA-1: axicabtagene ciloleucel (CAR-T) in refractory large B-cell lymphoma
summary: In 101 patients with refractory large B-cell lymphoma, one CAR-T infusion produced an objective response in 82% and a complete response in 54%.
why: Basis of the first CAR-T approvals for lymphoma (FDA, October 2017); needs specialist centres to manage cytokine release and neurotoxicity.
cr_title: Axicabtagene Ciloleucel CAR T-Cell Therapy in Refractory Large B-Cell Lymphoma

headline: Voretigene neparvovec (Luxturna): gene therapy for RPE65 retinal dystrophy
summary: A phase 3 trial of a one-time subretinal gene therapy showed improved functional vision in patients with biallelic RPE65 mutations.
why: First gene therapy approved for an inherited disease in the US (December 2017).
cr_title: Efficacy and safety of voretigene neparvovec (AAV2-hRPE65v2) in patients with RPE65 -mediated inherited retinal dystrophy: a randomised, controlled, open-label, phase 3 trial

headline: ORATORIO: ocrelizumab in primary progressive multiple sclerosis
summary: Ocrelizumab slowed confirmed disability progression versus placebo in primary progressive multiple sclerosis.
why: First therapy to show benefit in primary progressive MS (FDA, March 2017).
cr_title: Ocrelizumab versus Placebo in Primary Progressive Multiple Sclerosis

headline: Nusinersen in infantile-onset spinal muscular atrophy
summary: A motor-milestone response occurred in 51% of treated infants versus 0% with sham procedure.
why: First treatment for spinal muscular atrophy (FDA, December 2016); changed the outlook of a fatal infant disease.
cr_title: Nusinersen versus Sham Control in Infantile-Onset Spinal Muscular Atrophy

headline: Single-dose gene-replacement therapy for spinal muscular atrophy
summary: All 15 infants who received onasemnogene abeparvovec were alive and event-free at 20 months, compared with about 8% in historical controls.
why: Basis for Zolgensma, approved in 2019 as a one-time gene therapy.
cr_title: Single-Dose Gene-Replacement Therapy for Spinal Muscular Atrophy

headline: HAVEN 1: emicizumab prophylaxis in haemophilia A with inhibitors
summary: Weekly emicizumab lowered the bleeding rate by 87% compared with no prophylaxis.
why: Subcutaneous prophylaxis for haemophilia A, including patients with inhibitors (FDA, November 2017).
cr_title: Emicizumab Prophylaxis in Hemophilia A with Inhibitors

headline: Fourth Universal Definition of Myocardial Infarction
summary: Distinguishes myocardial infarction from non-ischaemic myocardial injury using a rise and fall of high-sensitivity troponin with clinical evidence of ischaemia, and classifies five types.
why: The standard definition behind emergency chest-pain pathways and diagnostic coding.
cr_title: Fourth universal definition of myocardial infarction (2018)

headline: ASPREE: low-dose aspirin in healthy older adults
summary: In 19,114 older adults without cardiovascular disease, aspirin did not prolong disability-free survival and increased major bleeding.
why: With ASCEND and ARRIVE, ended routine aspirin for primary prevention in older adults.
cr_title: Effect of Aspirin on Cardiovascular Events and Bleeding in the Healthy Elderly

headline: ASCEND: aspirin for primary prevention in diabetes
summary: In 15,480 adults with diabetes and no cardiovascular disease, aspirin reduced serious vascular events but increased major bleeding by a similar amount.
why: Showed that in diabetes the bleeding cost of aspirin offsets its vascular benefit in primary prevention.
cr_title: Effects of Aspirin for Primary Prevention in Persons with Diabetes Mellitus

headline: ARRIVE: aspirin for primary prevention at moderate cardiovascular risk
summary: In 12,546 patients at moderate risk, aspirin did not reduce the composite of cardiovascular events compared with placebo.
why: Third large trial in 2018 to find little net benefit from aspirin for primary prevention.
cr_title: Use of aspirin to reduce risk of initial vascular events in patients at moderate risk of cardiovascular disease (ARRIVE): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial

headline: 2018 ESC/ESH guidelines for the management of arterial hypertension
summary: European hypertension guidance: diagnosis at 140/90, treatment targets and a single-pill combination approach.
why: Reference for hypertension management outside the US until the 2024 update.
cr_title: 2018 ESC/ESH Guidelines for the management of arterial hypertension

headline: 2018 AHA/ACC cholesterol guideline
summary: Introduced risk-enhancing factors and threshold-based use of non-statin drugs; set an LDL-C threshold of 70 mg/dL for adding non-statin therapy in very-high-risk patients.
why: Shaped statin and add-on therapy decisions worldwide.
cr_title: 2018 AHA/ACC/AACVPR/AAPA/ABC/ACPM/ADA/AGS/APhA/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Guideline on the Management of Blood Cholesterol: A Report of the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association Task Force on Clinical Practice Guidelines

headline: Tisagenlecleucel (CAR-T) in children and young adults with B-cell leukaemia
summary: The overall remission rate was 81% within 3 months among 75 patients with relapsed or refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia.
why: Basis of the first CAR-T approval (FDA, August 2017).
cr_title: Tisagenlecleucel in Children and Young Adults with B-Cell Lymphoblastic Leukemia

headline: Larotrectinib in TRK fusion-positive cancers
summary: Across tumour types, 75% of patients with TRK fusion-positive cancers responded to larotrectinib.
why: An early tumour-agnostic approval: treatment chosen by the genetic change rather than the organ (FDA, November 2018).
cr_title: Efficacy of Larotrectinib in TRK Fusion–Positive Cancers in Adults and Children

headline: Baloxavir marboxil for uncomplicated influenza
summary: A single dose of baloxavir shortened symptoms versus placebo and reduced viral load faster than oseltamivir.
why: First new class of influenza antiviral in about two decades (FDA, October 2018).
cr_title: Baloxavir Marboxil for Uncomplicated Influenza in Adults and Adolescents

headline: Erenumab for episodic migraine prevention (STRIVE)
summary: Monthly erenumab reduced the number of migraine days per month compared with placebo.
why: First CGRP-pathway antibody for migraine prevention (FDA, May 2018).
cr_title: A Controlled Trial of Erenumab for Episodic Migraine

headline: DAPA-HF: dapagliflozin in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
summary: In 4,744 patients with or without diabetes, dapagliflozin lowered worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death by 26%.
why: Made SGLT2 inhibitors a core heart-failure drug regardless of diabetes.
cr_title: Dapagliflozin in Patients with Heart Failure and Reduced Ejection Fraction

headline: CREDENCE: canagliflozin protects the kidneys in diabetic kidney disease
summary: In 4,401 patients, canagliflozin reduced kidney failure, doubling of creatinine, or kidney or cardiovascular death by 30%.
why: First trial to show SGLT2 inhibitors slow kidney disease progression in diabetes.
cr_title: Canagliflozin and Renal Outcomes in Type 2 Diabetes and Nephropathy

headline: PIONEER 6: cardiovascular safety of oral semaglutide
summary: In 3,183 patients with type 2 diabetes, oral semaglutide was non-inferior to placebo for major cardiovascular events.
why: Supported the first oral GLP-1 receptor agonist (Rybelsus, FDA September 2019).
cr_title: Oral Semaglutide and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes

headline: Elexacaftor-tezacaftor-ivacaftor for cystic fibrosis
summary: In people with one F508del allele, the triple combination improved lung function (FEV1) by about 14 percentage points.
why: Effective for roughly 90% of people with cystic fibrosis (FDA, October 2019).
cr_title: Elexacaftor–Tezacaftor–Ivacaftor for Cystic Fibrosis with a Single Phe508del Allele

headline: PALM: monoclonal antibodies for Ebola virus disease
summary: Day-28 mortality was 33.5% with REGN-EB3 and 35.1% with mAb114, versus 49.7% with ZMapp and 53.1% with remdesivir.
why: First treatments proven to lower Ebola mortality.
cr_title: A Randomized, Controlled Trial of Ebola Virus Disease Therapeutics

headline: 2019 ACC/AHA guideline on the primary prevention of cardiovascular disease
summary: Prevention guidance centred on lifestyle, team-based care and shared decision-making; narrowed aspirin use.
why: Reset US primary-prevention practice, including aspirin.
cr_title: 2019 ACC/AHA Guideline on the Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease: A Report of the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association Task Force on Clinical Practice Guidelines

headline: 2019 ESC/EAS guidelines for the management of dyslipidaemias
summary: Lower LDL-C goals, including below 55 mg/dL (1.4 mmol/L) for very-high-risk patients.
why: The most aggressive lipid targets of their time and a model for later guidelines.
cr_title: 2019 ESC/EAS Guidelines for the management of dyslipidaemias: lipid modification to reduce cardiovascular risk

headline: 2019 ESC guidelines on chronic coronary syndromes
summary: Replaced 'stable coronary artery disease' with chronic coronary syndromes and organised testing by pre-test probability.
why: Changed how stable chest pain is investigated and labelled.
cr_title: 2019 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of chronic coronary syndromes

headline: Bedaquiline, pretomanid and linezolid (BPaL) for highly drug-resistant tuberculosis
summary: A favourable outcome was seen in 90% of 109 patients with extensively drug-resistant or treatment-intolerant multidrug-resistant tuberculosis.
why: Basis of a six-month, all-oral regimen; pretomanid was approved by the FDA in August 2019.
cr_title: Treatment of Highly Drug-Resistant Pulmonary Tuberculosis

headline: RECOVERY: dexamethasone lowers mortality in hospitalised COVID-19
summary: 28-day mortality fell among patients on ventilation (29.3% vs 41.4%) and on oxygen (23.3% vs 26.2%); no benefit without oxygen.
why: The first treatment shown to save lives in COVID-19; standard of care within weeks.
cr_title: Dexamethasone in Hospitalized Patients with Covid-19

headline: ACTT-1: remdesivir for COVID-19
summary: Remdesivir shortened time to recovery from 15 to 10 days in hospitalised adults.
why: First antiviral with a proven benefit in COVID-19.
cr_title: Remdesivir for the Treatment of Covid-19 — Final Report

headline: BNT162b2 mRNA vaccine: efficacy against COVID-19
summary: The Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine showed 95% efficacy against symptomatic COVID-19 in people aged 16 and over.
why: First mRNA vaccine authorised for use in humans (December 2020).
cr_title: Safety and Efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine

headline: DAPA-CKD: dapagliflozin in chronic kidney disease with or without diabetes
summary: In 4,304 patients, dapagliflozin reduced kidney failure, sustained eGFR decline of 50% or more, or death by 39%.
why: Extended kidney protection from SGLT2 inhibitors to people without diabetes.
cr_title: Dapagliflozin in Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease

headline: EMPEROR-Reduced: empagliflozin in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
summary: In 3,730 patients, empagliflozin lowered cardiovascular death or heart-failure hospitalisation by 25%.
why: Confirmed the heart-failure benefit of SGLT2 inhibitors first shown in DAPA-HF.
cr_title: Cardiovascular and Renal Outcomes with Empagliflozin in Heart Failure

headline: ISCHEMIA: invasive versus conservative strategy in stable coronary disease
summary: Over a median 3.2 years, an initial invasive strategy did not reduce death or myocardial infarction compared with optimal medical therapy in stable coronary disease with moderate or severe ischaemia.
why: Supports medical therapy first for many patients with stable symptoms.
cr_title: Initial Invasive or Conservative Strategy for Stable Coronary Disease

headline: 2020 ESC guidelines on atrial fibrillation
summary: Introduced the ABC pathway (anticoagulation, better symptom control, comorbidity management) and a structured approach to stroke prevention.
why: Standardised the integrated management of atrial fibrillation.
cr_title: 2020 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of atrial fibrillation developed in collaboration with the European Association for Cardio-Thoracic Surgery (EACTS)

headline: FIDELIO-DKD: finerenone in diabetic kidney disease
summary: In 5,734 patients, finerenone lowered kidney failure, sustained eGFR decline or kidney death by 18%.
why: Basis of finerenone (Kerendia), approved by the FDA in July 2021.
cr_title: Effect of Finerenone on Chronic Kidney Disease Outcomes in Type 2 Diabetes

headline: STEP 1: semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly for obesity
summary: Mean weight loss was 14.9% versus 2.4% with placebo at 68 weeks in 1,961 adults with overweight or obesity.
why: Established GLP-1 therapy as a major obesity treatment (Wegovy, FDA June 2021).
cr_title: Once-Weekly Semaglutide in Adults with Overweight or Obesity

headline: mRNA-1273 vaccine: efficacy against COVID-19
summary: The Moderna vaccine showed 94.1% efficacy against symptomatic COVID-19.
why: Second mRNA vaccine to show high efficacy; widely used in Saudi Arabia and worldwide.
cr_title: Efficacy and Safety of the mRNA-1273 SARS-CoV-2 Vaccine

headline: EMPEROR-Preserved: empagliflozin in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
summary: In 5,988 patients, empagliflozin lowered cardiovascular death or heart-failure hospitalisation by 21%.
why: First drug class to show benefit in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction.
cr_title: Empagliflozin in Heart Failure with a Preserved Ejection Fraction

headline: Sotorasib for KRAS G12C-mutated lung cancer
summary: About 37% of patients with previously treated non-small-cell lung cancer responded to sotorasib.
why: First drug to target KRAS, long considered untreatable (FDA, May 2021).
cr_title: Sotorasib for Lung Cancers with KRAS p.G12C Mutation

headline: Surviving Sepsis Campaign: international guidelines for sepsis and septic shock 2021
summary: Updated recommendations on screening, antimicrobial timing, fluids, vasopressors and corticosteroids.
why: Reference standard for sepsis care in emergency and critical care.
cr_title: Surviving sepsis campaign: international guidelines for management of sepsis and septic shock 2021

headline: 2021 ESC guidelines on cardiovascular disease prevention
summary: Introduced SCORE2 and SCORE2-OP risk estimation for fatal and non-fatal events.
why: Replaced SCORE with updated risk prediction across Europe and the Middle East.
cr_title: 2021 ESC Guidelines on cardiovascular disease prevention in clinical practice

headline: EPIC-HR: nirmatrelvir plus ritonavir for COVID-19 in high-risk adults
summary: Treatment started within 3 days of symptoms cut hospitalisation or death by 89% in non-hospitalised high-risk adults.
why: Basis of oral Paxlovid, authorised from December 2021.
cr_title: Oral Nirmatrelvir for High-Risk, Nonhospitalized Adults with Covid-19

headline: SURPASS-2: tirzepatide versus semaglutide in type 2 diabetes
summary: HbA1c fell by 2.0 to 2.3 percentage points with tirzepatide versus 1.9 with semaglutide 1 mg, with greater weight loss.
why: Basis of tirzepatide (Mounjaro), the first dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist (FDA, May 2022).
cr_title: Tirzepatide versus Semaglutide Once Weekly in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes

headline: SURMOUNT-1: tirzepatide for obesity
summary: Weight fell by 15.0%, 19.5% and 20.9% with 5, 10 and 15 mg versus 3.1% with placebo at 72 weeks.
why: Set a new benchmark for drug-induced weight loss (Zepbound, FDA November 2023).
cr_title: Tirzepatide Once Weekly for the Treatment of Obesity

headline: CLARITY-AD: lecanemab in early Alzheimer's disease
summary: Lecanemab slowed decline on the CDR-SB scale by 27% over 18 months; amyloid-related imaging abnormalities occurred.
why: First anti-amyloid antibody with full FDA approval (July 2023); registered in Saudi Arabia in July 2025.
cr_title: Lecanemab in Early Alzheimer’s Disease

headline: DELIVER: dapagliflozin in heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction
summary: In 6,263 patients, dapagliflozin lowered worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death by 18%.
why: Extended SGLT2-inhibitor benefit across the ejection-fraction spectrum.
cr_title: Dapagliflozin in Heart Failure with Mildly Reduced or Preserved Ejection Fraction

headline: EMPA-KIDNEY: empagliflozin in chronic kidney disease
summary: In 6,609 patients, empagliflozin lowered kidney disease progression or cardiovascular death by 28%.
why: Confirmed SGLT2 inhibitors as standard therapy in many forms of chronic kidney disease.
cr_title: Empagliflozin in Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease

headline: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA guideline for the management of heart failure
summary: Four-drug foundation (ARNI/ACE inhibitor/ARB, beta-blocker, mineralocorticoid antagonist, SGLT2 inhibitor) and a new category for improved ejection fraction.
why: Defines modern heart-failure drug therapy.
cr_title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure: A Report of the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association Joint Committee on Clinical Practice Guidelines

headline: Monkeypox virus infection in humans across 16 countries
summary: A series of 528 infections described the clinical features of the 2022 outbreak; 98% were in gay or bisexual men.
why: Described the global mpox outbreak declared a public-health emergency by the WHO on 23 July 2022.
cr_title: Monkeypox Virus Infection in Humans across 16 Countries — April–June 2022

headline: ZUMA-7: axicabtagene ciloleucel as second-line therapy for large B-cell lymphoma
summary: Event-free survival was superior with CAR-T therapy compared with standard second-line care.
why: Moved CAR-T from last resort to second-line treatment.
cr_title: Axicabtagene Ciloleucel as Second-Line Therapy for Large B-Cell Lymphoma

headline: Betibeglogene autotemcel gene therapy for transfusion-dependent beta-thalassaemia
summary: Most treated patients with non-β0/β0 genotypes became transfusion independent.
why: Relevant where thalassaemia is common, including the Gulf (FDA, August 2022).
cr_title:
Betibeglogene Autotemcel Gene Therapy for Non–β
            <sup>0</sup>
            /β
            <sup>0</sup>
            Genotype β-Thalassemia

headline: SELECT: semaglutide lowers cardiovascular events in obesity without diabetes
summary: In 17,604 adults with established cardiovascular disease and overweight or obesity, weekly semaglutide reduced major cardiovascular events by 20%.
why: Showed that treating obesity pharmacologically can reduce heart attacks and strokes.
cr_title: Semaglutide and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Obesity without Diabetes

headline: RSV vaccine in adults 60 years and older
summary: The prefusion F vaccine had 82.6% efficacy against RSV lower respiratory tract disease.
why: First RSV vaccines for older adults were approved in May 2023 (Arexvy, Abrysvo).
cr_title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus Prefusion F Protein Vaccine in Older Adults

headline: Maternal RSV vaccine to protect infants
summary: Vaccination in pregnancy had 81.8% efficacy against severe RSV lower respiratory illness in infants within 90 days.
why: Basis of the first maternal RSV vaccine (Abrysvo).
cr_title: Bivalent Prefusion F Vaccine in Pregnancy to Prevent RSV Illness in Infants

headline: Exagamglogene autotemcel (Casgevy) for sickle cell disease
summary: 29 of 30 evaluable patients were free of severe vaso-occlusive crises for at least 12 months.
why: First CRISPR-based therapy approved (UK November 2023, FDA December 2023; Saudi Arabia January 2024).
cr_title: Exagamglogene Autotemcel for Severe Sickle Cell Disease

headline: Exagamglogene autotemcel (Casgevy) for transfusion-dependent beta-thalassaemia
summary: 39 of 42 patients were transfusion independent for at least 12 months.
why: A one-time gene-editing option for a disease that is common in the Middle East.
cr_title: Exagamglogene Autotemcel for Transfusion-Dependent β-Thalassemia

headline: A new nomenclature for steatotic liver disease: MASLD and MASH
summary: NAFLD and NASH are replaced by metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and steatohepatitis (MASH), with positive cardiometabolic criteria.
why: Changes the terminology in reports, codes and trials.
cr_title: A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature

headline: Cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) health: AHA presidential advisory
summary: Defines CKM syndrome and staging linking obesity, diabetes, chronic kidney disease and cardiovascular disease.
why: Frames these conditions as one connected disease process.
cr_title: Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Health: A Presidential Advisory From the American Heart Association

headline: 2023 ESC guidelines for the management of acute coronary syndromes
summary: Updated recommendations on diagnosis with high-sensitivity troponin, antithrombotic therapy and early invasive strategy.
why: Reference for acute coronary syndrome care in emergency departments.
cr_title: 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of acute coronary syndromes

headline: STELLAR: sotatercept in pulmonary arterial hypertension
summary: Sotatercept improved six-minute walk distance by about 41 metres versus placebo when added to background therapy.
why: A new class of drug for pulmonary arterial hypertension (Winrevair, FDA March 2024).
cr_title: Phase 3 Trial of Sotatercept for Treatment of Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension

headline: TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2: donanemab in early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease
summary: Donanemab slowed clinical decline by 35% on iADRS in patients with low or medium tau.
why: Basis of donanemab (Kisunla), approved by the FDA in July 2024.
cr_title: Donanemab in Early Symptomatic Alzheimer Disease

headline: MAESTRO-NASH: resmetirom in NASH with liver fibrosis
summary: NASH resolution occurred in 26 to 30% versus 10% with placebo; fibrosis improved in 24 to 26% versus 14%.
why: First drug approved for MASH with fibrosis (Rezdiffra, FDA March 2024).
cr_title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Controlled Trial of Resmetirom in NASH with Liver Fibrosis

headline: FLOW: semaglutide and kidney outcomes in type 2 diabetes
summary: Semaglutide lowered major kidney disease events by 24% in patients with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease.
why: Added GLP-1 receptor agonists to the kidney-protection toolkit.
cr_title: Effects of Semaglutide on Chronic Kidney Disease in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes

headline: KDIGO 2024 clinical practice guideline for chronic kidney disease
summary: Updated evaluation and management, including risk-based staging and SGLT2-inhibitor use.
why: Reference guideline for chronic kidney disease worldwide.
cr_title: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Chronic Kidney Disease

headline: 2024 ESC guidelines for the management of elevated blood pressure and hypertension
summary: Introduced an 'elevated blood pressure' category (120 to 139 / 70 to 89 mmHg) and a systolic target of 120 to 129 mmHg for most treated adults.
why: Moves European practice toward earlier, lower-target treatment.
cr_title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of elevated blood pressure and hypertension

headline: 2024 ESC guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation
summary: The AF-CARE pathway: comorbidity management, avoid stroke, better symptom control, evaluation and dynamic reassessment.
why: Updated the structure of atrial fibrillation care.
cr_title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation developed in collaboration with the European Association for Cardio-Thoracic Surgery (EACTS)

headline: PURPOSE 1: twice-yearly lenacapavir for HIV prevention in young women
summary: There were no HIV infections among the 2,134 women who received lenacapavir.
why: Basis of the first twice-yearly HIV prevention injection.
cr_title: Twice-Yearly Lenacapavir or Daily F/TAF for HIV Prevention in Cisgender Women

headline: SURMOUNT-OSA: tirzepatide in obstructive sleep apnoea with obesity
summary: Tirzepatide reduced the apnoea-hypopnoea index by about 25 to 29 events per hour.
why: First drug approved for obstructive sleep apnoea (FDA, December 2024).
cr_title: Tirzepatide for the Treatment of Obstructive Sleep Apnea and Obesity

headline: ENHANCE-1: ensifentrine in COPD
summary: Ensifentrine improved FEV1 by about 87 mL at 12 weeks.
why: First new inhaled mechanism for COPD in about 20 years (FDA, June 2024).
journal: American Journal of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine
cr_title: Ensifentrine, a Novel Phosphodiesterase 3 and 4 Inhibitor for the Treatment of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease: Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Phase III Trials (the ENHANCE Trials)

headline: 2025 AHA/ACC guideline for the prevention, detection, evaluation and management of high blood pressure in adults
summary: Uses the PREVENT equations to guide earlier treatment, with team-based care and attention to out-of-office measurement.
why: Updates US hypertension practice for the first time since 2017.
cr_title: 2025 AHA/ACC/AANP/AAPA/ABC/ACCP/ACPM/AGS/AMA/ASPC/NMA/PCNA/SGIM Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults: A Report of the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association Joint Committee on Clinical Practice Guidelines

headline: Definition and diagnostic criteria of clinical obesity (Lancet Commission)
summary: Separates clinical obesity (obesity with organ dysfunction or functional limitation) from preclinical obesity.
why: Changes how obesity is diagnosed and who is prioritised for treatment.
cr_title: Definition and diagnostic criteria of clinical obesity

headline: Patient-specific in vivo gene editing to treat a rare metabolic disease
summary: A personalised base-editing therapy was designed, made and given to an infant with CPS1 deficiency in a few months.
why: First personalised gene-editing treatment for a single patient.
cr_title: Patient-Specific In Vivo Gene Editing to Treat a Rare Genetic Disease
